title: Economic Activities Dataset — Invest Gate KSA
description: Blueprint schema for future economic-activities.en.json and economic-activities.ar.json datasets. No activity data has been added yet — this schema defines the architectural foundation. Field definitions are provisional and will be refined when the dataset is first populated. See docs/en/activity-taxonomy.md for the conceptual rationale.

activity_entry.description: A single economic activity entry. IDs are stable, language-agnostic, and identical across language files.

id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Identical across language files. Must not change once published.

classification.description: Classification codes and references for this activity. Both ISIC4 and Saudi national classification are tracked separately because the mapping is not always one-to-one.

isic4.description: ISIC Revision 4 classification reference. All sub-fields are nullable — they should be populated during verification but may be null in draft entries pending research.

class.description: Four-digit ISIC4 class code — the most granular level.

label.description: Official ISIC4 label for the matched class, group, or division.

alignment_note.description: Notes on alignment quality — e.g. partial match, span across multiple classes, or where the Saudi activity has no direct ISIC4 equivalent.

saudi.description: Saudi national activity classification reference. Codes and names must come from official Saudi sources — do not infer or approximate. All sub-fields are nullable pending verification.

activity_code.description: Official Saudi activity code as assigned in the national classification or MISA approved activities list. Must be verified against the live official source before populating.

activity_name_en.description: Official English activity name exactly as it appears in the MISA approved activities list or equivalent official publication. Must not be paraphrased.

activity_name_ar.description: Official Arabic activity name exactly as it appears in the MISA approved activities list or equivalent official publication. Must not be paraphrased.

on_misa_approved_list.description: Whether this activity appears on the MISA approved activities list for foreign investors. Null if not yet verified.

alignment_note.description: Notes on the Saudi classification — e.g. where the Saudi code diverges from ISIC4, splits an ISIC4 class into sub-activities, or covers a narrower scope than the ISIC4 class.

related_sectors.description: IDs of sector entries (from data/sectors.*.json) that this activity falls within. An activity may map to more than one sector.

likely_authorities.description: Regulatory authorities likely relevant to this specific activity beyond the universal MISA and Ministry of Commerce step. Only activity-specific authorities should be listed here.

related_license_concepts.description: IDs of investment-license concepts (from data/investment-licenses.*.json) applicable to this activity.

common_confusions.description: Known points of confusion about this activity's scope, classification, or regulatory path.

notes.description: Freeform notes — edge cases, cross-references, or caveats not captured in other fields. Descriptive only.

verification_status.description: 'draft' = not yet verified against live official sources. 'verified' = contributor has reviewed the live source and all placeholders are resolved.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent verification against a live official source, or a placeholder string when status is draft.

verification_method.description: What was reviewed and how during the most recent verification — e.g. 'Reviewed MISA approved activities list, confirmed activity code and name, checked ISIC4 alignment against UNSD publication.'

placeholders.description: Unresolved fields pending verification. Must be non-empty when verification_status is 'draft'. Each placeholder must name the specific field, explain what needs to be verified, and point to the official source.
